---
title: "Hybrid Quantum-Classical Machine Learning for COVID-19"
date: 2021-03-01
categories: [quantum machine learning, classification]
description: "A quantum-classical classifier using amplitude embedding and transfer learning."
image: ../images/qml.jpeg
---

This project classified COVID-19 cases from clinical features such as hematocrit, hemoglobin, platelets, red blood cells, lymphocytes, and MCHC. The pipeline embedded classical data into quantum states and used a hybrid quantum-classical model for classification.
